appStore.name: Gobblo: ADHD Task Pet
appStore.subtitle: Feed it by starting tasks
appStore.promotionalText: Can't start? Start for 2 minutes. Your pet works next to you, eats your tasks and grows. No streaks, no guilt, no account.
appStore.description:
Your brain isn't lazy. It's hungry.

Gobblo is a small pet that eats your to-do list. You feed it by starting a task. Even 2 minutes counts.

HOW IT WORKS
• Dump everything in your head. Gobblo chops it into small bites.
• Tap a bite and start for 2 minutes. That is the whole trick.
• Your pet works next to you while the timer runs.
• Done? Feed it. It grows, levels up and unlocks hats.

MADE FOR BRAINS THAT STRUGGLE TO START
• No streaks to lose. Away for a week? Your pet just says hi.
• Nudges are capped. You choose how many, and quiet hours stay quiet.
• Can't pick? Your pet picks one for you.
• Stuck? Get one tiny first step.
• Calm tools: breathing, grounding and a 20-second shake-out.

YOURS, ON YOUR PHONE
• No account and no sign-up.
• Your tasks stay on your device.
• Works offline.

FREE
Everything you need to start a task is free: brain dump, focus timer, reminders, repeating tasks, the pet and its 20 levels.

GOBBLO PLUS (optional)
One purchase, no subscription: the full closet, extra rooms, the lock screen focus timer and routine packs. Once you have it, it is yours.

Gobblo is a productivity app made for ADHD brains. It is not a medical device and it does not diagnose or treat any condition.

Privacy policy: https://anosswb.github.io/gobblo/privacy
Terms of use: https://anosswb.github.io/gobblo/terms
